warp.slot_granularity: one Unicode code point for visible text; one synthetic sign for a source-critical zero-width event

empty_anchor.count_policy: at most one technical anchor per inscription, only when no primary source-text slot exists

primary_text.word_policy: Create word nodes only from a selected, validated IIP transcription_segmented source projected deterministically onto primary source-text slots.

section_policy.inscription: One node per parsed non-test IIP record; spans every native textual-layer slot belonging to the record.
section_policy.textpart: Layer-aware. Preserve explicit EpiDoc textpart divisions; create one implicit textpart for each non-empty textual layer lacking explicit textparts.
section_policy.section_part: Stable unique heading within an inscription: layer plus explicit subtype/n when supplied, otherwise the layer name.
section_policy.line: Line 1 starts at the beginning of a textpart; each source lb starts the following line. The lb event itself is a synthetic sign and line_break markup node.
section_policy.empty_editions: Preserve edition nodes but do not invent line nodes for empty editions.

text-orig-full.description: Default normalized/source-selected inscription text; all non-primary layer slots render empty.

text-layer-full.description: Literal stored-slot view for one edition/textpart/line; may expose both editorial reading branches. Use primary/source/layer-specific selected formats for reading selection.

node_type_contract.inscription: Record and top-level section node. Canonical TF section id is the unique source file stem; raw IIP/xml ids remain metadata.
node_type_contract.edition: One node for each source transcription, diplomatic, translation, or commentary layer, including empty source layers.
node_type_contract.textpart: Explicit or implicit layer-aware section part.
node_type_contract.line: Layer-aware source line derived from lb boundaries.
node_type_contract.word: IIP segmented token (w/num/orig) projected to primary source-text slots; never guessed.
node_type_contract.markup: Structured inline EpiDoc/editorial phenomenon, including zero-width events; kind is enumerated.
node_type_contract.entity: Text-anchored named/reference entity in translation or other textual layers.
node_type_contract.segmentation: Provenance node for each transcription_segmented candidate and its #20 resolution status.
node_type_contract.image: Facsimile/image reference and credit only; never image bytes.

paragraph.semantics: Textual block boundary inside an edition/textpart; preserves block-level language/certainty and multiple-block order without becoming a TF section.

node_type_contract.bibl_scope: One source biblScope child; repeatable and parented to a bibl node.
node_type_contract.dimension: One source dimensions element; repeatable and usable for object/surface or hand/letter dimensions without flattening ranges.
node_type_contract.support_note: One non-empty direct support/p source paragraph; repeatable and parented to the inscription.
node_type_contract.facsimile_surface: One source facsimile/surface grouping node; top-level surfaces belong to the inscription and nested surfaces retain surface parentage.

glyph.semantics: Literal Unicode code point on a visible source/text slot; empty on synthetic slots.

after.semantics: Semantically retained inter-sign/inter-token separator after this slot; source indentation is not copied.

lang.semantics: Effective source language code without silently collapsing IIP distinctions such as he/heb/hbo.

source_key.semantics: Deterministic converter key for a source element lacking xml:id; never an opaque XML fragment.

quantity.semantics: Exact raw source quantity string; never coerced in-place.

quantity_int.semantics: Optional lossless integer derivative of quantity; absent when the raw value is not an exact integer.

date_not_before_int.semantics: Optional lossless integer-year derivative of date_not_before.

date_not_after_int.semantics: Optional lossless integer-year derivative of date_not_after.

genre_cert.semantics: Exact raw source msItem/@cert value qualifying genre/classification.

date_precision.semantics: Exact raw source origin date/@precision value.

region_cert.semantics: Exact raw source origin region/@cert value.

settlement_cert.semantics: Exact raw source origin settlement/@cert value.

point_index.semantics: TF serialization of canonical IR point_index for zero-width semantic markup; record-local boundary offset.

point_relation.semantics: Relation of the zero-width semantic point to its single technical oslots anchor.

display_readings.preservation: All observed alternative/editorial branches receive slots or structured zero-width markup; display formats choose among them without deleting the other branch.

expansion.normalized: abbr lexical content plus ex; abbreviation marks remain structured markup
expansion.source: abbr/am source content; ex is suppressed from source-oriented display

supplied.normalized: included and marked by supplied markup
supplied.source: not rendered as physically present; supplied node and slots remain queryable

deletion_and_surplus.normalized: not rendered in normalized primary view unless source construct semantics require otherwise
deletion_and_surplus.source: retained for source-oriented rendering and always queryable

display_readings.unclear: Visible text remains rendered; uncertainty is represented by markup/cert features.
display_readings.gap: No fabricated glyph. App/browser may render a marker from structured gap features.

selected_candidate_nodes.suppressed_content_policy: Suppressed candidates are not duplicated as text. Empty/equivalent candidates preserve provenance; researched metadata conflicts preserve their differing summary fields; any unknown semantic conflict fails before conversion.

metadata.anchor_semantics: technical containment only; use in_inscription edge for semantic ownership

semantic_zero_width_markup.semantics: Record-local boundary offset in InscriptionIR.signs; 0 is before the first sign, len(signs) is after the last sign, interior k is between signs[k-1] and signs[k].
semantic_zero_width_markup.segmented_projection: Preserve a deterministic projected boundary; prefer a unique compatible native empty-markup point inside monotonic token bounds and fail closed on ambiguity.
semantic_zero_width_markup.tf_serialization: Issue #5 must map the semantic point to a technical adjacent oslots anchor plus an explicit reconstructable point relation; the technical anchor is not the semantic span.

edges.parent: Direct semantic parent for nested markup/entity nodes and repeatable source structures such as paragraph blocks, bibliography scopes, hand dimensions, and facsimile images/surfaces; preserves hierarchy even when oslot anchors coincide.
edges.in_inscription: Explicit ownership of metadata/segmentation nodes whose oslot anchor is technical.
edges.corresponds_to: Resolved local EpiDoc @corresp relation between edition/text nodes; unresolved/raw value remains source_corresp.
edges.cites: Resolved ana/bibliography relation to bibl nodes; raw ana value is retained.
edges.segmentation_of: Selected/suppressed segmentation candidate provenance linked to the edition it annotates/projects onto.
edges.token_from: Word node linked to the selected segmentation provenance node.

identity.inscription_id: Unique repository filename stem for the pinned source record (for example jaff0105).
identity.iip_id: Preserve idno[@type='IIP'] verbatim as non-unique source metadata.
identity.xml_id: Preserve TEI/@xml:id verbatim as non-unique-across-files source metadata.
identity.source_id: Preserve xml:id verbatim where present; interpret uniqueness only inside the source file unless an explicit file-qualified reference says otherwise.
identity.source_key: Deterministic file-scoped structural key for a source element lacking xml:id.
identity.cross_file_reference_policy: Require an explicit file-qualified target; never resolve a bare duplicated xml:id globally by guess.
identity.normalization: Never overwrite a raw source identifier/value with a derived canonical value.

provenance.image_rights_boundary: Preserve image references/credits only; do not redistribute image binaries without separately established rights.

deliberately_absent: morphology features not present in IIP
compatibility.rule: Reuse names only when semantics match; compatibility is not cosmetic aliasing.

failure_policy.malformed_xml: explicit source-accounting failure; issue #15 policy applies
failure_policy.duplicate_identity: duplicate canonical record key or duplicate source element id within the same source file is release-blocking; cross-file raw IIP/xml id collisions are preserved and diagnosed
failure_policy.metadata_cardinality_loss: forbidden; repeatable source children must remain repeatable TF nodes

tf_value_types.rule: Every TF feature has exactly one valueType. Raw source attributes are string features; optional numeric derivatives use separately named int features.

source_mapping_policy.completeness_test: tests/test_schema_contract.py compares mapping keys with docs/research/iip-inventory.json
source_mapping_policy.fig_desc: figDesc text is editorial description on the enclosing figure markup node and is not rendered as inscription glyphs.
source_mapping_policy.segmented_annotations: Selected transcription_segmented inline structures are source annotation nodes anchored to the deterministically projected primary slots and tagged annotation_source=transcription_segmented.
